title: Edit Ledger
commonMistakes: Forgetting that turning the empty string into a non-empty string still costs insertions
Using a greedy left-to-right comparison that is not optimal
Mixing up the insertion and deletion transitions
Allocating a full matrix when only the previous row is needed
followUps: How would the answer change if replacement cost twice an insertion?
How would you reconstruct the actual sequence of edits?
How would you compute the distance between two very long strings with limited memory?
attribution: Problem statement, explanation, and solutions by the Base Case contributors. Example and test provenance is under audit.
